envelope.description: Adapt design review to durable background admission in its worker

body.title: Adapt design review to durable background admission in its worker
body.summary: Integrate the existing DesignReviewCoordinator and design subject/admission/planning/chunk/impact paths with the same dedicated worker lifecycle and resource-guard writer. Preserve live artifact monitoring and the current family-specific recovery/technical retry protocol; test registry-backed execution without production cutover yet.
acceptanceChecks: Start/recover acknowledges only after durable unverified input, before expensive subject/history checks; planning/providers cannot run before qualification.
Epic, standalone and ISSUE-derived artifact routes retain their required ancestry and reviewer-author independence checks.
Coherent chunks, completed-feedback persistence, impact-selected corrections, final consistency and bounded technical retry behavior are preserved.
Subject changes invalidate under existing user-directed restart rules; unrelated external changes do not restart the review.
Design subject claims, controller exchanges and resource intents remain coherent across worker failure/recovery and concurrent reviewers.

Connect design-family subject claims and controller admission/execution/exchanges to the main registry contract from t8; concurrent worker subject exclusions and trusted successful exchanges are proven without relying on worker-local globals for cross-worker authority.

tests.name: src/workflow/review/design-review/__tests__/worker-admission.test.ts: durable admission and current workflow ancestry run in the owner worker
src/workflow/review/design-review/__tests__/worker-admission.test.ts: subject invalidation explicit recovery and impact-selected chunks preserve saved feedback
